plan.title: Learning attribution boundary
plan.goal: Ensure non-agent and unknown task outcomes remain raw observations without reward, penalty, or learning-side state changes.

items.name: Freeze attribution contract
items.goal: Obtain independent review of outcome compatibility, eligibility, and trust-boundary decisions before code changes.
items.validation_goal: Reviewer freeze records an approved eligibility table or explicit amendment.

items.name: Wire explicit attribution
items.goal: Carry optional attribution through existing interaction tracking and outcome-update ingress, retaining raw observations.
items.validation_goal: Focused ingress tests prove absent failure attribution is unknown and all defined classes reach the tracker.

items.name: Gate learning sinks
items.goal: Block non-agent and unknown observations from scoring, context, patterns, procedural memory, and training contribution.
items.validation_goal: Regression tests assert every sink is suppressed for infrastructure_error, infeasible, cancelled, and unknown while eligible legacy success/partial behavior remains compatible.

items.name: Validate bounded slice
items.goal: Run focused regressions and syntax validation with evidence before handoff.
items.validation_goal: Focused pytest and py_compile commands pass against edited tracker and handler modules.
